title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 6.44
exact_target: Historical question: is the integrated convolution of two real-coefficient normalized univalent functions univalent? The source update gives a counterexample.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2306044 (AMR-022-6044). CC BY 4.0.
